summary.en: Forty years ago, Yuri was charged of transporting a jewel for a live drama, but was never found back until in 2015, when a construction worker and a real estate agent found her body inside a rusty car at the bottom of a dried up Ogouchi Dam. Forty years ago, after Yuri's disappearance, the Tears of Borgia also disappeared. As of now, they are still missing. In the scenario of "I Killed Them", a thief known as Red Hood targets the jewel of a rich family and, to avoid getting robbed, the owners decide to let the real jewel on the maid's fingers while a fake one is hidden in the safe but Red Hood is no other than the butler with whom the maid has fallen in love. Someone has killed Mizusawa before the planned arrival of Kogoro at the real estate agency at six and erased all the data on his phone. The culprit also tried to burn all the evidence. Responding to Sho's invitation to his workplace, Kogoro goes there but no one answers. He enters by the unlocked front door, finds the unconscious body of Sho Mizusawa and is trapped in a dangerous fire. Will he escape?
